questions.question: What do you enjoy most about doing research? / 科研中你最享受的是什么
questions.answer:
What I enjoy most about research is the moment when a vague problem gradually becomes clearer. At the beginning, I may only have an intuition. Then I read, run experiments, and check whether the evidence supports it. Sometimes the result is different from what I expected, and that is also interesting. I enjoy this process of asking a question, testing it, and updating my understanding.

科研中我最享受的，是一个模糊的问题逐渐变清楚的过程。刚开始时，我可能只有一个直觉。之后我会读文献、做实验，再看证据是否真的支持这个想法。有时候结果和预期不一样，这反而也很有意思。我喜欢这种提出问题、验证问题，再不断更新自己理解的过程。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: What is your understanding of your prospective supervisor's research area? / 你怎样理解意向导师的研究领域
questions.answer:
I chose your university mainly because of research fit. I am interested in [research area], and I have read about the work of Professor [name] and the group. Their focus on [specific problem] connects well with my experience in computer vision, robotics, and AI agents. I also want stronger training in [method or skill]. At the same time, I can bring hands-on experience in building and evaluating real AI systems. So my choice is based on a concrete match, not only on the university's reputation.

我选择贵校最主要的原因是研究匹配。我对[研究方向]感兴趣，也了解过[导师姓名]老师及团队在[具体问题]上的工作，这和我过去在计算机视觉、机器人以及AI Agent方面的经历能够衔接。我也希望在[方法或能力]上接受更系统的训练。同时，我可以带来真实AI系统构建和评测方面的实践经验。因此，我的选择不是只看学校名气，而是看具体的研究和培养是否适合我。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Why do you want to pursue graduate study? / 你为什么希望读研
questions.answer:
I considered this question from the perspective of what I want to learn next. My project experience taught me how to build systems, but it also showed me the limits of my current knowledge. I can implement an idea, but I still need stronger training in research design, evaluation, and deeper theory. A full-time graduate program gives me the time and environment to focus on these skills. So for me, graduate study is not a delay before working. It is the most direct way to prepare for the kind of work I want to do.

我主要从“下一步真正需要学什么”来考虑这个问题。项目经历让我学会了做系统，但也让我看到自己目前的能力边界：我可以实现一个想法，但在研究设计、评测方法和更深入的理论上还需要系统训练。全日制研究生阶段能提供更集中的时间和环境。因此，对我来说，读研不是把工作往后拖，而是为未来想做的事情做更直接的准备。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: What connections do you see among your research projects? / 你如何看待研究项目之间的联系
questions.answer:
Although my projects dealt with different topics, they all allowed me to explore related questions beyond the classroom. In each project, I gained hands-on experience in collecting information and analyzing evidence, but each one also helped me deepen my understanding of the same broader issue from a different perspective. Together, they taught me to connect theoretical knowledge with real-world problems and gradually confirmed my interest in pursuing a clearer research direction.

虽然我的几个项目涉及不同主题，但它们都让我能够在课堂之外继续探索相互关联的问题。在每个项目中，我都获得了信息收集和证据分析方面的实践经验；与此同时，每个项目也让我从不同角度加深了对同一个宽泛问题的理解。这些经历共同教会我把理论知识与现实问题联系起来，也逐渐进一步确认了我想研究的方向。研究生阶段，我希望以过去在这些项目中的经验为基础继续发展，而不是把它们视为彼此割裂的经历。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: What strengths do you have that are relevant to this field? / 你有哪些与本领域相关的优势
questions.answer:
One strength of mine is persistence. I have played the violin for many years, and the same habit helps me in study and research. When a problem is difficult, I can stay with it and improve step by step. I also like turning ideas into working systems instead of stopping at a concept. One weakness is that I sometimes spend too much time refining details before the main structure is fixed. I am improving this by setting priorities and time limits, and by asking myself what is really necessary at each stage.

我的一个优势是比较能长期坚持。我学小提琴很多年，这种习惯也影响了我的学习和科研：遇到难题时，我愿意一点一点把它做下去。另外，我比较喜欢把想法真正做成可以运行的系统。我的不足是有时会在整体框架还没完全确定时，就花太多时间打磨细节。现在我会先定优先级和时间上限，并不断问自己“这个阶段最需要解决的是什么”。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Why did you choose this major? / 你为什么选择这个专业
questions.answer:
I chose Computer Science because it connects abstract ideas with systems that can actually run. Courses such as Machine Learning taught me how models learn from data, while Operating Systems and Compiler Principles helped me understand what happens underneath. Project work made this interest stronger. In the repair-robot project, an algorithm only became useful when it could work with planning, tool calls, and feedback. That combination of theory, engineering, and real-world impact is what keeps me interested in Computer Science.

我选择计算机，是因为它能把抽象的思想变成真正可以运行的系统。机器学习让我理解模型怎样从数据中学习，操作系统和编译原理又让我看到更底层的机制。项目经历进一步验证了这种兴趣。在维修机器人项目里，算法只有和规划、工具调用、执行反馈连起来以后才真正有价值。理论、工程和现实影响之间的这种结合，是我想继续学计算机的原因。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Could you briefly introduce your undergraduate major? / 请简要介绍一下你的本科专业
questions.answer:
My major is Computer Science and Technology. It covers both how computation works and how we build reliable software systems. My coursework includes algorithms, operating systems, compiler principles, software engineering, machine learning, and data mining. What I value most is that the major trains both abstraction and implementation. You need to understand a principle, but you also need to make it work under real constraints. That combination has shaped the way I approach research and engineering problems.

我的专业是计算机科学与技术。它既研究计算本身的原理，也关注怎样构建可靠的软件和智能系统。我的课程包括算法、操作系统、编译原理、软件工程、机器学习和数据挖掘等。我最看重的是这个专业同时训练抽象思维和实现能力：既要理解原理，也要让它在真实约束下运行。这种训练很大程度上影响了我处理科研和工程问题的方式。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Why do you want to switch to a different major? / 你为什么希望转换专业
questions.answer:
My decision is not a sudden change. I gradually developed an interest in the new field through elective courses, independent reading, and practical experience. I was particularly drawn to the way it approaches questions that I had already encountered in my undergraduate studies. I therefore began to explore the field beyond the classroom and deepen my understanding of its basic ideas.

这个决定并不是突然作出的。我通过选修课程、自主阅读和实践经历，逐渐对新的领域产生了兴趣。我尤其被它处理本科阶段已经接触过的一些问题的方式所吸引。因此，我开始在课堂之外继续探索这个领域，并加深对其基本理念的理解。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Why do you want to pursue this area as your research direction? / 你为什么希望将这个方向作为研究领域
questions.answer:
My current interest is reliable intelligent systems, especially AI agents and multimodal decision-making in real-world tasks. I am interested in two questions. First, how can an agent choose and use tools based on intermediate feedback instead of following a fixed script? Second, how can we evaluate when such a system is reliable enough to act, and when it should stop or ask for help? These questions connect well with my previous experience in robotics, autonomous-driving diagnosis, and multimodal models.

我目前比较感兴趣的是真实场景中的可靠智能系统，尤其是AI Agent和多模态决策。我比较关注两个问题：第一，智能体怎样根据中间反馈选择和调用工具，而不是只按固定流程执行；第二，我们怎样判断一个系统什么时候足够可靠可以行动，什么时候应该停止或请求帮助。这些问题和我之前在机器人、自动驾驶诊断以及多模态模型方面的经历比较一致。
tags: P01 专业选择与学术动机

questions.question: Why should we offer you a place in our program? / 我们为什么应该录取你
questions.answer:
Good morning, professors. My name is Zhexuan Li. I am a Computer Science student at Hangzhou Dianzi University. My GPA is 4.589 out of 5.0, and I rank 19th out of 465 students. My main project experience is in computer vision, robotics, and AI agents. In an industrial repair-robot project, I worked on visual detection and designed a lightweight attention module called LECA. That work led to a first-author paper. These experiences made me interested in reliable intelligent systems, especially AI agents that can perceive, plan, use tools, and learn from feedback. Thank you.

各位老师好，我叫黎哲轩，来自杭州电子科技大学计算机科学与技术专业。我的GPA是4.589/5.0，专业排名19/465。本科期间，我主要做过计算机视觉、机器人和AI Agent相关项目。在工业维修机器人项目中，我负责视觉检测，并设计了轻量级注意力模块LECA，相关工作形成了一篇第一作者论文。这些经历让我逐渐关注真实场景中的可靠智能系统，尤其是能够感知、规划、调用工具并根据反馈调整的AI Agent。
tags: P02 院校、学院与导师匹配

questions.question: Why would you like to work with this supervisor? / 你为什么希望跟随这位导师学习
questions.answer:
I looked into the professor's research through recent papers and project introductions. The way the research connects careful analysis with meaningful questions stood out to me. This work fits my current interests and is relevant to my previous experience in project-based learning. I believe it would allow me to use what I have already learned in information analysis and benefit from guidance in research design and academic reasoning.

我通过近期论文和项目介绍进一步了解了这位老师的研究。这些研究把严谨分析与有意义的问题联系起来，这一点尤其吸引我。老师的研究与我的学术兴趣高度一致，也与我过去在项目式学习方面的经历相关。我相信，这能让我以过去在信息分析方面的经验为基础继续发展，并从研究设计和学术推理方面的指导中受益。
tags: P02 院校、学院与导师匹配

questions.question: Do you have any questions for us? / 你有什么问题想问我们
questions.answer:
Yes, thank you. I have learned more about the program through its curriculum and research information, and its emphasis on student development stood out to me. Since the training fits my current interests and fits the direction I want to explore, I would like to ask how first-year students usually become involved in ongoing research. I would also like to know how students benefit from guidance in developing independent research questions.

有，谢谢。我已经通过培养方案和研究信息进一步了解了这个项目，其中对学生成长的重视尤其吸引我。由于这里的培养与我的学术兴趣高度一致，也符合我希望发展的方向，我想请问一年级学生通常如何参与正在开展的研究。我也想了解，学生如何从形成独立研究问题的指导中受益。
tags: P02 院校、学院与导师匹配

questions.question: What kind of relationship would you like to build with your supervisor? / 你希望与导师建立怎样的关系
questions.answer:
I hope to build a relationship based on open communication, mutual respect, and growing independence. At the beginning, I would like to benefit from guidance in research design and academic thinking, especially when learning how to define a worthwhile question. At the same time, I should bring a solid foundation in independent learning and responsible work habits rather than wait passively for instructions.

我希望与导师建立一种以坦诚沟通、相互尊重和逐步独立为基础的关系。刚开始时，我希望能够从研究设计和学术思考方面的指导中受益，尤其是学习如何提出值得研究的问题。同时，我也应该具备自主学习和认真负责方面的扎实基础，而不是被动等待指令。我希望以过去在自我管理学习方面的经验为基础继续发展，而导师的研究也符合我希望发展的方向。

questions.question: Which other universities or programs have you applied to? / 你还申请了哪些学校或项目

I would clearly separate programs I have only applied to from programs where I have already interviewed or received a result. My choices are mainly based on research direction, supervisor fit, training style, and long-term development. After that, I would explain why this program is a particularly good fit for me.

questions.question: How do you usually read academic papers? / 你通常如何阅读学术论文
questions.answer:
I usually read a paper in several passes. First, I look at the title, abstract, figures, and conclusion to understand the problem and the main claim. Then I read the method and experiments with specific questions: what is really new, what baseline is used, and whether the evidence supports the claim. If the paper is important to my work, I go back to the details and sometimes reproduce part of it. I also use AI tools to explain difficult passages, but I always return to the original paper and verify the key points myself.

我通常会分几遍读论文。第一遍先看标题、摘要、图和结论，弄清它解决什么问题、核心结论是什么。第二遍带着问题看方法和实验：真正的新东西是什么、和什么baseline比较、证据是否支持结论。如果这篇论文和我的工作很相关，我会再回到细节，必要时做部分复现。我也会用AI辅助解释难句，但关键结论一定会回到原文自己核对。

questions.question: How do you balance coursework, research, student work, and extracurricular activities? / 你如何平衡课程、科研、学生工作和课外活动
questions.answer:
I first separate fixed deadlines from tasks that can move. Coursework and application deadlines get a clear time block, while research is divided into smaller weekly goals. I also keep one or two activities, such as music or exercise, because they help me stay stable rather than simply filling every hour with work. When several tasks conflict, I decide what matters most for the current stage and accept that not everything can be optimized at the same time.

我会先把有硬性截止时间的事情和可以调整的事情分开。课程和申请节点会固定时间，科研则拆成较小的周目标。我也会保留音乐或运动这类活动，因为它们能帮助我保持稳定，而不是把每个小时都塞满。任务冲突时，我会判断当前阶段什么最重要，也接受不可能同时把所有事情都做到最优。

questions.question: Which academic journals do you usually read in your field? / 你平时关注本领域的哪些学术期刊
questions.answer:
I follow several influential journals in my field, but I do not try to read every article they publish. I read with a clear purpose and select papers related to the questions I am currently studying. Review articles help me build a solid foundation in an unfamiliar topic, while recent research helps me keep up with developments in my field. I also compare ideas and findings across papers instead of relying on a single source.

我会关注本领域一些有影响力的期刊，但不会试图阅读其中发表的每篇文章。我会带着明确目的阅读，选择与当前学习问题相关的论文。综述文章能够帮助我在陌生主题上打下扎实基础，近期研究则帮助我跟进本领域的发展。我也会比较不同论文的观点和发现，而不是依赖单一来源。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: How do you keep up to date with developments in your field and current affairs? / 你如何跟进本领域的最新发展和时事
questions.answer:
I use a combination of academic journals, university or institutional websites, and reliable news sources. I read with a clear purpose and first check who produced the information, what evidence it uses, and whether other reliable sources support it. For academic topics, I compare ideas and findings across papers rather than depend on a single study. This helps me identify gaps in my understanding and keep up with recent developments in my field.

我会综合使用学术期刊、高校或专业机构网站以及可靠的新闻来源。我会带着明确目的阅读，首先检查信息由谁发布、使用了什么证据，以及是否得到其他可靠来源的支持。对于学术主题，我会比较不同论文的观点和发现，而不是依赖某一项研究。这帮助我发现自己理解中的缺口，并跟进本领域的最新发展。

questions.question: Could you introduce a recent paper you have read? / 请介绍你最近读过的一篇论文
questions.answer:
Recently, I read a paper related to my current academic interests. I chose it because I usually read with a clear purpose, and I wanted to understand how researchers approached an important question in the field. The paper helped me deepen my understanding of the relationship between research questions, methods, and evidence. I also compared its ideas and findings with those of other papers and used the differences to identify gaps in my understanding.

最近，我阅读了一篇与目前学术兴趣相关的论文。我选择它，是因为我通常会带着明确目的阅读，而当时希望了解研究者如何处理本领域的一个重要问题。这篇论文帮助我加深了对研究问题、研究方法和证据之间关系的理解。我还会把它的观点和发现与其他论文进行比较，并通过其中的差异发现自己理解中的缺口。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: How did you achieve a good result in this course? / 你是如何在这门课中取得好成绩的
questions.answer:
I did not rely on last-minute revision. From the beginning, I tried to build a solid foundation in the basic concepts and develop a structured approach to weekly review. I broke difficult chapters down into manageable parts and used exercises to identify gaps in my understanding. When I remained unsure, I would seek clarification and feedback from the teacher or classmates.

我没有依靠考前突击。从课程开始时，我就努力在基本概念方面打下扎实基础，并形成有条理的每周复习方法。我会把困难章节拆分成容易处理的部分，再通过练习发现自己理解中的缺口。如果仍有不确定的地方，我会向老师或同学主动寻求解释和反馈。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: Which undergraduate course impressed you most, and why? / 哪门本科课程给你的印象最深，为什么
questions.answer:
One course that influenced me a lot was Operating Systems. It was challenging because topics such as processes, memory management, and concurrency are closely connected. I used mind maps to organize the concepts instead of memorizing them separately, and I achieved a good result in the course. More importantly, it taught me to reason from mechanisms. In system-level problems, a small misunderstanding can cause a large error, so the course also trained me to be more precise and systematic.

对我影响很大的一门课是操作系统。它的难点在于进程、内存管理、并发等概念彼此联系很紧。我后来用思维导图把知识结构串起来，而不是零散记忆，最后也取得了比较好的成绩。更重要的是，这门课让我习惯从机制出发去理解问题。系统层面的一个小误解可能造成很大的错误，所以它也训练了我的严谨性和系统思维。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: How would you evaluate your English proficiency? / 你如何评价自己的英语水平
questions.answer:
I can read academic papers independently and communicate in English, but my spoken English is not yet as automatic as my reading. My CET-4 score is 575 and my CET-6 score is 547. The main issue I am working on is active recall: sometimes I know a word when I see it, but cannot retrieve it quickly when speaking. So I am now practicing short answers, pronunciation, paper reading, and real-time conversation every day.

我可以独立阅读英文论文，也能够用英语交流，但口语的自动化程度还没有阅读高。我的四级575分、六级547分。现在最主要的问题是主动提取：有些词看见认识，但说话时不能立刻想起来。因此我目前每天练短句回答、发音、论文朗读和实时对话。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: How do you manage your time and stay organized? / 你如何管理时间并保持条理
questions.answer:
I use a simple rule: deadlines first, then the most important long-term task. I break large tasks into small actions that can be finished in one sitting, because vague tasks are easy to postpone. I also set a minimum daily goal. On a difficult day, finishing the minimum keeps the project moving. At the end of the day, I review what actually took time and adjust the next plan instead of making an overly detailed schedule.

我的方法比较简单：先处理有截止时间的事情，再保证最重要的长期任务持续推进。我会把大任务拆成一次可以完成的小动作，因为模糊任务最容易拖延。同时我会设一个每天的最低目标，状态不好时至少完成这个最低量。晚上再根据实际耗时调整第二天计划，而不是把日程表做得过度精细。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: Could you describe your study habits and learning methods? / 请描述你的学习习惯和方法
questions.answer:
When I learn a difficult topic, I first try to build a structure rather than memorize details. For example, in Operating Systems I used mind maps to connect processes, memory management, and concurrency. After I understand the structure, I use exercises or small implementations to test whether I really understand it. I also explain the idea in my own words. If I cannot explain it simply, I usually have not understood it well enough yet.

学习难点内容时，我会先搭知识结构，而不是先背细节。例如学习操作系统时，我用思维导图把进程、内存管理和并发串起来。理解结构后，再通过题目或小实现检查自己是否真的掌握，并尝试用自己的话解释。如果一个概念我还不能简单讲清楚，通常说明理解还不够。
tags: P03 课程学习与学术成长

questions.question: What was innovative about your research project? / 你的研究项目有什么创新之处
questions.answer:
The main innovation is in how channel information is summarized. Lightweight attention methods are efficient, but a single pooled descriptor may lose useful statistics. LECA keeps lightweight cross-channel interaction and adds several learnable statistical descriptors, including information related to feature variation and activation strength. These descriptors are not hard rules. They are signals that the network can learn to use. The goal is to improve channel calibration without introducing a heavy attention block.

这篇论文的主要创新在于通道信息怎样被汇总。轻量级注意力方法效率很高，但如果只使用单一的池化描述，可能会丢掉一些有用统计信息。LECA保留轻量的跨通道交互，同时加入与特征变化和激活强度相关的可学习统计描述。这些统计量不是人工硬规则，而是供网络学习利用的信号，目标是在不引入重型注意力模块的情况下改善通道校准。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: What role and responsibilities did you have in the project? / 你在项目中承担了什么角色和职责
questions.answer:
I am responsible for the overall research design and the diagnostic framework of the project. I helped define the main hypotheses, designed the comparison between fixed evidence collection, greedy strategies, and agent-based diagnosis, and worked on the experimental pipeline. I also take part in checking whether the environment can produce valid evidence. I try to keep the boundary clear: some infrastructure and system components are team work, while my main responsibility is the research question, diagnostic method, and evaluation design.

我主要负责这个项目的整体研究设计和诊断框架，包括定义核心假设、设计固定证据、greedy策略和Agent诊断之间的对比，以及推进实验流程。我也会参与检查实验环境能否产生可信证据。我会明确区分个人和团队贡献：部分基础设施和系统组件是团队合作，我的主要责任是研究问题、诊断方法和评测设计。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: What research methods did you use in your project? / 你在项目中使用了什么研究方法
questions.answer:
We first clarified the question and then chose a method suited to the question rather than selecting a method simply because it was familiar. The method allowed us to collect and analyze the evidence in a consistent way. I took responsibility for preparing part of the material and conducting part of the analysis. During the process, we had to work through unexpected problems involving data quality and implementation.

我们首先明确研究问题，随后选择了适合研究问题的方法，而不是因为熟悉某种方法就直接采用。这个方法使我们能够以一致的方式收集和分析证据。我主要负责准备部分材料并完成部分分析。研究过程中，我们还需要逐步解决数据质量和实施方面的意外问题。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Could you explain the mechanism behind this key concept in your project? / 请解释你项目中这个关键概念背后的机制
questions.answer:
I am familiar with channel attention. The basic idea is simple: not every feature channel is equally useful for the current input, so the network learns a weight for each channel. A typical method first summarizes each channel, then models the relationship between channels, and finally rescales the feature maps. In my work, I built on this idea and designed LECA. I added lightweight statistical descriptors so the network could use richer information when calibrating channels, while keeping the parameter cost low.

我比较熟悉通道注意力。它的核心思想很简单：对于当前输入，不同特征通道的重要性并不一样，因此网络学习一个权重去重新调整各通道。典型方法会先对每个通道做信息汇总，再建模通道之间的关系，最后对特征图重新加权。在我的工作里，我基于这个思路设计了LECA，引入轻量级统计描述，让网络在通道校准时利用更丰富的信息，同时尽量保持较低的参数开销。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: What did you learn from your research experience? / 通过科研、论文与项目复盘你学到了什么
questions.answer:
The biggest lesson I learned is that research is not just about getting a better number. You first need a clear question. Then you need evidence that actually answers that question. In my earlier work, I sometimes focused too quickly on improving a model. Later I learned to look at failure cases, compare baselines, and ask what the result really proves. I also learned that negative results are useful if they help us reject a weak idea or find a problem in the experimental setup.

我从科研中学到最重要的一点是，科研不是只把指标做高。首先要有一个清楚的问题，然后要有真正能回答这个问题的证据。我早期有时会太快进入“怎么把模型提升”的思路，后来逐渐学会看失败样本、做baseline比较，并追问实验结果到底证明了什么。我也开始接受负结果，因为它可以帮助我们排除一个不好的想法，或者发现实验设计中的问题。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: What conclusions did your project reach, and what is its practical value? / 你的项目得出了什么结论，有什么现实价值
questions.answer:
After we collected and analyzed the evidence, we found a consistent relationship relevant to the question we were studying. We interpreted the findings carefully and drew an evidence-based conclusion instead of claiming a stronger result than the data allowed. The practical value is that the findings can provide a reference for understanding or improving the issue in similar situations. At the same time, we recognized the limitations of the data and research setting.

在收集和分析证据后，我们发现了一个与研究问题相关且较为一致的关系。我们谨慎解释了研究发现，并得出了有证据支持的结论，没有作出超出数据允许范围的判断。它的现实价值在于，这些发现能够为理解或改善类似情境中的问题提供参考。同时，我们也认识到数据和研究情境的局限。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Could you briefly introduce your paper? / 请简要介绍你的论文
questions.answer:
My first-author paper is about screw detection in difficult industrial scenes. Small screws can be easily missed under reflections, uneven lighting, and complex backgrounds. I designed a lightweight channel-attention module called LECA. It extends lightweight cross-channel interaction with additional statistical descriptors, so the network can use richer information when recalibrating feature channels. We evaluated it in our detection task and observed improvements with a small parameter cost. The paper was published in an IEEE-indexed conference.

我的第一作者论文主要研究复杂工业场景下的螺栓检测。小螺栓在反光、光照不均和复杂背景下比较容易漏检。我设计了一个轻量级通道注意力模块LECA，在轻量跨通道交互的基础上加入额外统计描述，让网络在重新校准特征通道时使用更丰富的信息。我们在检测任务中进行了实验，在较小参数开销下取得了提升。论文已经在IEEE会议发表并检索。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Could you describe a project you completed recently? / 请介绍你最近完成的一个项目
questions.answer:
One of my most memorable experiences was working on an industrial repair robot. At first, I thought the main challenge was simply to improve the detection model. But after we connected perception with robot actions and tool calls, I realized that a good model is only one part of a real system. Interfaces, feedback, and failure handling are equally important. That project changed the way I think about AI. It moved my interest from isolated model performance to complete intelligent systems.

我大学里最难忘的一段经历，是做工业维修机器人项目。刚开始我以为核心问题就是把检测模型做得更准，但当我们把感知和机器人动作、工具调用连起来之后，我才真正意识到，一个好模型只是完整系统的一部分，接口、反馈和失败处理同样重要。这个项目改变了我看待AI的方式，也让我从关注单点模型性能，逐渐转向完整智能系统。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Could you describe one of your research experiences? / 请描述你的一段科研、论文与项目复盘
questions.answer:
One of my most memorable experiences was working on an industrial repair robot. At first, I thought the main challenge was simply to improve the detection model. But after we connected perception with robot actions and tool calls, I realized that a good model is only one part of a real system. Interfaces, feedback, and failure handling are equally important. That project changed the way I think about AI. It moved my interest from isolated model performance to complete intelligent systems.

我大学里最难忘的一段经历，是做工业维修机器人项目。刚开始我以为核心问题就是把检测模型做得更准，但当我们把感知和机器人动作、工具调用连起来之后，我才真正意识到，一个好模型只是完整系统的一部分，接口、反馈和失败处理同样重要。这个项目改变了我看待AI的方式，也让我从关注单点模型性能，逐渐转向完整智能系统。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: If you were given a new research topic, how would you develop a research idea? / 如果给你新的研究课题，你会如何展开思路
questions.answer:
I would first clarify the broad topic and focus on the question of what is not yet well understood. I would then review the relevant literature to learn what has already been studied and where disagreements or gaps remain. Based on the available data and time, I would narrow the topic down to a clear and researchable question. Next, I would choose a method suited to the question and consider how to collect and analyze the evidence.

我会先弄清宽泛主题，并关注其中哪些问题尚未得到充分理解。随后，我会梳理相关文献，了解已有研究、现存分歧和可能的空白。根据可以获得的数据和时间，我会把主题缩小为一个清晰且可以研究的问题。接下来，我会选择适合研究问题的方法，并考虑如何收集和分析证据。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: How did you choose the topic of your research project? / 你是如何确定研究项目选题的
questions.answer:
The topic developed gradually rather than appearing all at once. We began by reviewing the relevant literature and noticing that an important question had not been fully explained. We then focused on the question of how that issue appeared in a specific setting and narrowed the topic down to something we could investigate with the available resources. Before making the final decision, we considered the data, time, and methods we could realistically use, and chose a method suited to the question.

这个选题是逐渐形成的，并不是一次就确定下来。我们首先梳理了相关文献，注意到一个重要问题尚未得到充分解释。随后，我们关注这个问题如何在特定情境中出现，并把主题缩小到能够利用现有资源开展研究的范围。最终确定之前，我们考虑了可以实际获得的数据、时间和方法，并选择了适合研究问题的方法。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Have you published any papers? / 你有发表过论文吗
questions.answer:
Yes. I am the first author of a paper on lightweight channel attention for screw detection in difficult industrial scenes. The paper presents LECA, a lightweight module that uses richer statistical descriptors for channel calibration. It has been published and indexed. I also have experience participating in other research and paper writing, but I keep the status of each work clear and do not describe ongoing submissions as published results.

有。我有一篇第一作者论文，研究复杂工业场景下螺栓检测中的轻量级通道注意力，提出了LECA模块，通过更丰富的统计描述进行通道校准。该论文已经发表并检索。我也参与过其他科研和论文写作，但我会严格区分不同工作的状态，不会把在投稿件说成已经发表。
tags: P04 科研、论文与项目复盘

questions.question: Tell us about a time when you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it? / 讲一次你与队友意见不合的经历
questions.answer:
In one project, a teammate and I preferred different ways of presenting the results. Instead of defending my idea immediately, I tried to listen to different points of view and keep communication open. We agreed to focus on the issue rather than the person and compared the two options against our shared goal, available evidence, and time limit. This helped us reach a solution everyone could support and keep the project on track.

在一次项目中，我和一位队友对结果的呈现方式有不同看法。我没有立刻坚持自己的方案，而是努力听取不同观点并保持坦诚沟通。我们约定对事不对人，再根据共同目标、现有证据和时间限制比较两种方案。这帮助我们形成了大家都能支持的方案，也确保项目按计划推进。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: What would you do if a teammate failed to complete their share of the work? / 如果队友没有完成分内工作，你会怎么做
questions.answer:
I would first speak with the teammate privately and keep communication open rather than assume that the person was irresponsible. I would try to understand the difficulty and focus on the issue rather than the person. Then we would make responsibilities clear again and agree on a realistic next step.

我会先私下与这位成员沟通并保持坦诚沟通，而不是直接认定对方不负责任。我会努力了解实际困难，并坚持对事不对人。之后，我们会重新明确各自的职责，商定一个现实的下一步。如果截止日期临近，我会根据团队需要调整自己的角色，并在必要时主动补位，但仍会让这位成员承担适当责任。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: What kind of relationship would you like to build with your supervisor? / 你希望与导师建立怎样的关系
questions.answer:
I hope to build a relationship based on respect, honest communication, and growing independence. Both sides should work toward a shared goal, while the student should make responsibilities clear and report progress reliably. I would try to keep communication open, especially when I encounter a difficulty or disagree with a suggestion. At the same time, I should listen to different points of view and focus on the issue rather than the person.

我希望与导师建立一种以尊重、坦诚沟通和逐步独立为基础的关系。双方应当朝着共同目标努力，而学生需要明确自己的职责并可靠地汇报进展。遇到困难或对某项建议有不同看法时，我会努力保持坦诚沟通。与此同时，我也应该听取不同观点并坚持对事不对人。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: Why are interpersonal skills important, and how do you develop them? / 人际交往能力为什么重要，你如何提升
questions.answer:
Interpersonal skills matter because even strong individual work has to be understood, coordinated, and improved through interaction with others. I develop these skills by trying to keep communication open, listen to different points of view, and focus on the issue rather than the person. In team settings, I also adjust my role to the needs of the team and step in when support is needed.

人际交往能力很重要，因为即使个人工作做得很好，也需要通过与他人互动才能被理解、协调和改进。我会努力保持坦诚沟通、听取不同观点，并坚持对事不对人，以此发展自己的沟通能力。在团队中，我也会根据团队需要调整自己的角色，并在必要时主动补位。重要任务结束后，我会复盘团队的合作方式，思考自己是否清楚表达了观点、是否妥善回应了反馈。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: What is your view of teamwork? / 你怎么看待团队合作
questions.answer:
For me, teamwork is not simply dividing a task into equal pieces. A good team needs clear ownership, shared interfaces, and frequent communication about problems. I learned this in engineering competitions and robot projects. If one module changes, other members need to know how it affects their work. I also think disagreement can be useful when it is about evidence and design rather than personal preference. The goal is not to avoid conflict, but to make the system and the decision better.

我理解的团队合作并不是把任务平均切成几块。好的团队需要明确责任、统一接口，并及时沟通问题。我在工程竞赛和机器人项目里体会很深：一个模块发生变化，其他成员必须知道它会怎样影响自己的部分。我也认为基于证据和设计的分歧是有价值的，目标不是完全避免冲突，而是让系统和决策变得更好。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: Could you share an experience of working on a team project? / 请分享一次团队项目的合作经历
questions.answer:
In one undergraduate project, our team had to work toward a shared goal within a limited period. At first, progress was uneven, so we made our responsibilities clear and agreed to keep communication open through regular updates. I adjusted my role to the needs of the team and stepped in when support was needed, especially when one task fell behind. This helped us keep the project on track and complete the final presentation on time.

在一次本科项目中，我们需要在有限时间内朝着共同目标努力。最初，各部分进度并不一致，因此我们重新明确了各自的职责，并约定通过定期更新保持坦诚沟通。我会根据团队需要调整自己的角色，也会在某项任务落后时主动补位。这些做法帮助我们确保项目按计划推进，并按时完成最终汇报。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: Have you ever led a project or team? / 你有过带领项目或团队的经历吗
questions.answer:
Yes. I have served as a project leader in competition and project work, and I was also a deputy leader of a student orchestra. These two experiences were quite different, but both taught me that leadership is mostly about coordination. I need to make the goal clear, assign ownership, notice where a teammate is blocked, and make decisions when information is incomplete. I do not think a leader needs to do every task personally; the important thing is to keep the team moving in the same direction.

有。我在竞赛和项目中担任过负责人，也做过学生乐团副队长。两种经历很不同，但都让我认识到，领导更多是协调：把目标讲清楚、明确责任、及时发现队友卡在哪里，并在信息不完整时做决定。我不认为负责人必须亲自完成所有事情，真正重要的是让团队朝同一个方向持续推进。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: What role do you usually play in a team? / 你通常在团队中承担什么角色
questions.answer:
I usually take a role that connects technical work with coordination. In several projects I was responsible for an algorithm module, but I also paid attention to how it connected with data, interfaces, or other teammates' work. If the team already has a clear leader, I am comfortable focusing on my module and reporting problems early. If coordination is missing, I am also willing to step forward and organize the next actions.

我在团队里通常会承担“技术执行加协调”的角色。有些项目中我负责算法模块，但也会关注它和数据、接口以及其他成员工作的衔接。如果团队已经有明确负责人，我可以专注自己的模块并及时暴露问题；如果缺少协调，我也愿意主动把下一步任务组织起来。
tags: P05 团队合作、领导力与沟通

questions.question: Tell us about a time when you failed. How did you respond? / 讲一次你失败的经历，你是如何应对的
questions.answer:
In one assignment, my first submission did not meet the standard I had expected. I decided to face the problem directly and identify what had gone wrong instead of blaming the deadline or the task itself. I sought feedback from others, considered several possible solutions, and adjusted my approach accordingly. Although I could not completely change the original result, I made a realistic plan for improvement and performed better in later work.

在一次任务中，我第一次提交的成果没有达到自己的预期。我决定直接面对问题并找出问题出在哪里，而不是归咎于截止日期或任务本身。我向他人寻求反馈、考虑了几种可能的解决方案，并据此调整了自己的做法。虽然原有结果无法完全改变，但我制定了现实的改进计划，之后的表现也有所提升。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: How do you handle stress and setbacks? / 你如何应对压力和挫折
questions.answer:
When I feel stressed, I first try to make the next step clear. If several tasks are mixed together in my head, the pressure usually becomes worse. So I list the tasks, set priorities, and focus on one small action first. I also like running. When I have been sitting for a long time or feel mentally tired, a short run usually helps me relax and clear my mind. For a setback, I try to ask what information it gives me and what I should change next.

我压力比较大时，第一件事是先把下一步要做什么弄清楚。如果很多事情一起堆在脑子里，压力往往会更大，所以我会列出来、排优先级，然后先完成一个很小但明确的动作。我也喜欢跑步。坐久了或者脑子很累时，出去跑一会儿通常能让我放松下来、重新理清思路。遇到挫折时，我会再看它到底提供了什么信息，以及下一步应该改什么。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: What would you do if you were not admitted? / 如果没有被录取，你会怎么做
questions.answer:
I would certainly feel disappointed, but I would not treat the result as a final judgment of my ability. I would face the situation directly and try to identify what I still need to improve. If possible, I would seek feedback from others and focus on what I can control, such as strengthening my knowledge, research preparation, and interview skills. I would then make a realistic plan for improvement and adjust my next step accordingly.

如果没有被录取，我当然会感到失望，但不会把这个结果看成对个人能力的最终判断。我会直接面对这种情况，并努力找出自己仍需改进的地方。如果条件允许，我会向他人寻求反馈，并专注于自己能够控制的部分，例如加强专业知识、科研准备和面试能力。之后，我会制定现实的改进计划，并据此调整下一步安排。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: Tell us about a problem you solved and how you approached it. / 讲一次你解决问题的经历及其处理方式
questions.answer:
When I encountered the problem, I first identified what had gone wrong and broke the problem down into manageable parts. I then considered several possible solutions and compared them in terms of time, feasibility, and likely effect. Before making a decision, I sought feedback from others to check whether I had missed an important factor. I selected the most practical option and adjusted my approach accordingly as new information appeared.

遇到问题后，我首先找出问题出在哪里，并把问题拆分成容易处理的部分。随后，我考虑了几种可能的解决方案，从时间、可行性和预期效果等方面进行比较。作出决定前，我向他人寻求反馈，检查自己是否遗漏了重要因素。之后，我选择了最现实的方案，并随着新信息出现据此调整自己的做法。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: How do you approach difficulties and challenges? / 你如何应对困难和挑战
questions.answer:
My first step is to face the problem directly and identify what has gone wrong or what remains unclear. I then break the problem down into manageable parts and consider several possible solutions instead of trying the first idea repeatedly. If necessary, I seek feedback from others and adjust my approach accordingly. Throughout the process, I focus on what I can control and keep track of whether each action is producing useful progress.

面对困难时，我首先会直接面对问题，并找出哪里出了问题或还有哪些地方不清楚。接着，我会把问题拆分成容易处理的部分，并考虑几种可能的解决方案，而不是不断重复第一个想法。必要时，我会向他人寻求反馈并据此调整自己的做法。在整个过程中，我会专注于自己能够控制的部分，并检查每项行动是否带来了有效进展。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: What difficulty did you encounter in your research, and how did you overcome it? / 你在科研中遇到了什么困难，如何克服的
questions.answer:
In the repair-robot project, one difficult problem was screw detection under complex lighting. The targets were small, and reflections or similar structures could easily cause false detections. I did not treat it as a single “model problem.” I checked the data, failure cases, and feature behavior, then tested different improvements. This process led me to design LECA, a lightweight channel-attention module. The experience taught me that a useful improvement should come from understanding the failure pattern, not from adding complexity blindly.

在维修机器人项目里，一个比较难的问题是在复杂光照下检测螺栓。目标本身很小，反光和相似结构又容易造成误检。我没有把它只当成“换个模型”的问题，而是去检查数据、失败样本和特征表现，再逐步测试不同改进。这个过程最终让我设计了轻量级通道注意力模块LECA。它让我明白，有价值的改进应该来自对失败模式的理解，而不是盲目增加复杂度。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: Why was your grade in this course relatively low? / 为什么你这门课的成绩相对较低
questions.answer:
The grade was lower than I expected, and I think the main responsibility was mine. I tried to face the problem directly and identify what had gone wrong. I realized that I had understood individual facts but had not built a clear structure for the course. I therefore sought feedback from others, adjusted my approach accordingly, and made a realistic plan for improvement based on regular review and practice.

这门课的成绩低于我的预期，我认为主要责任在自己。我努力直接面对问题并找出问题出在哪里。我意识到，自己虽然记住了一些零散知识，却没有建立清晰的课程框架。因此，我主动向他人寻求反馈、据此调整了自己的做法，并通过定期复习和练习制定了现实的改进计划。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: What is your greatest weakness? / 你最大的不足是什么
questions.answer:
One weakness I am working on is that I sometimes spend too much time refining details before the main structure is settled. This can reduce my efficiency, especially when several tasks are happening at the same time. I am improving it in two ways. First, I decide the main goal before polishing details. Second, I set a time limit for each stage. This helps me keep the work moving instead of trying to make every small part perfect too early.

我正在改进的一个不足是，有时候整体框架还没有完全确定，我就会花太多时间打磨细节。事情一多时，这会影响效率。现在我主要用两个办法改进。第一，先确定这个阶段最重要的目标，再处理细节；第二，给每个阶段设时间上限。这样可以让我先把事情往前推进，而不是过早追求每个小地方都做到完美。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: What key issues did the reviewers raise, and how did you address them? / 审稿人提出了哪些关键意见，你是如何回应的
questions.answer:
The main comments concerned the clarity of the argument and whether the evidence fully supported the conclusion. I tried to face the problem directly and identify what had gone wrong in the original presentation. I broke the comments down into manageable parts and considered several possible revisions for each issue. After discussing them with my supervisor, I sought feedback from others and adjusted my approach accordingly.

审稿意见主要涉及论证是否清晰，以及证据能否充分支持结论。我努力直接面对问题，并找出原有表达中存在的问题。我把审稿意见拆分成容易处理的部分，针对每项问题考虑了几种可能的修改方案。与导师讨论后，我进一步向他人寻求反馈并据此调整了做法。
tags: P06 困难、压力、失败与问题解决

questions.question: Could you tell us about a presentation or speech you gave? / 请介绍一次公开演讲或汇报经历。
questions.answer:
In one academic presentation, I took responsibility for organizing the main argument and presenting part of the results. I took the initiative to study the audience's likely questions and had to learn independently about several points that were not clear enough. During preparation, I practiced how to communicate ideas clearly and used simple examples to explain complex content. I also worked effectively with others to keep the slides and spoken explanation consistent.

在一次学术汇报中，我主要负责组织核心论点并汇报部分结果。我会主动考虑听众可能提出的问题，也需要针对一些尚不清楚的内容进行自主学习。准备过程中，我练习如何清楚表达观点，并用简单例子说明复杂内容。我还与他人高效合作，确保幻灯片与口头讲解保持一致。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Could you describe one of your internship experiences? / 请介绍一段实习经历。
questions.answer:
During my internship, I had to adapt to unfamiliar tasks and understand how work was organized in a professional setting. I took the initiative to learn independently before asking focused questions and then took responsibility for collecting information, organizing materials, and supporting routine analysis. The experience allowed me to apply what I had learned in practice, communicate ideas clearly, and work effectively with others.

实习期间，我需要适应陌生任务，并了解专业工作环境中的组织方式。我会先主动进行自主学习，再提出有针对性的问题，之后主要负责信息收集、材料整理和基础分析支持。这段经历让我能够把所学知识运用到实践中、清楚表达观点，并与他人高效合作。它也让我认识到，专业工作不仅看个人表现，还需要可靠性以及对整个团队需要的关注。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Why did you not participate in research or academic competitions? / 你为什么没有参加科研或学术竞赛？
questions.answer:
I did not have a formal research or competition experience during that period, and I would not try to present ordinary coursework as something it was not. However, I worked to build a solid foundation in my major, maintain steady academic performance, and learn independently beyond the minimum course requirements. Through course papers and group assignments, I also tried to apply what I had learned in practice, communicate ideas clearly, and work effectively with others.

那一阶段，我确实没有参加正式科研或学术竞赛，我也不会把普通课程作业包装成它们并不是的经历。不过，我一直努力在本专业打下扎实基础、保持稳定的学业表现，并在最低课程要求之外进行自主学习。通过课程论文和小组作业，我也尝试把所学知识运用到实践中、清楚表达观点并与他人高效合作。现在我认识到，自己应当更早主动寻找研究机会，也已经做好在研究生阶段适应陌生任务的准备。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: What is your greatest strength? / 你最大的优势是什么？
questions.answer:
I think my greatest strength is persistence. I have studied the violin for about fifteen years, so I am used to improving something slowly through repeated practice. The same habit also appears in my study and project work. When a problem is difficult, I usually do not give it up immediately. I try to break it down, find the part I can work on, and improve it step by step. I think this kind of steady effort is one of my strengths.

我觉得自己最大的优势是比较能坚持。我学小提琴大约十五年了，所以很习惯通过反复练习，一点一点把一件事情做好。这种习惯也会带到学习和项目里。遇到比较难的问题时，我通常不会马上放弃，而是先把问题拆开，找到当前能推进的部分，再一步一步改进。我觉得这种稳定的投入是我的一个优势。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Could you describe yourself in three words? / 请用三个词概括自己。
questions.answer:
I would describe myself as responsible, proactive, and adaptable. I am responsible because I take responsibility for the work assigned to me and try to demonstrate my ability through concrete results. I am proactive because I take the initiative to learn independently rather than wait for every step to be explained. I am adaptable because I can adapt to unfamiliar tasks and work effectively with others when the situation changes.

我会用负责、主动和适应力强来概括自己。我认为自己负责，是因为我会对分配给自己的工作承担责任，并努力通过具体结果证明自己的能力。我认为自己主动，是因为我会主动进行自主学习，而不是等待别人解释每一个步骤。我认为自己适应力较强，是因为情况变化时，我能够适应陌生任务并与他人高效合作。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Could you introduce one of your most important awards or qualifications? / 请介绍一项重要奖项或资格。
questions.answer:
My competition experience mainly falls into two types. One is engineering and system building. For example, I served as the project leader in the Service Outsourcing Competition, where our team won a national third prize. The other is mathematical modeling. I won a provincial first prize in the China Undergraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling and later received an Honorable Mention in MCM. These competitions trained different skills, but they all taught me how to learn quickly, divide work, validate results, and deliver under time pressure.

我的竞赛经历主要可以分成两类。一类是工程系统类，比如服务外包大赛，我担任项目负责人，团队最终获得全国赛企业命题类三等奖。另一类是数学建模，我获得过全国大学生数学建模竞赛浙江省一等奖，后来在美赛中获得Honorable Mention。这些比赛训练的技能不同，但共同让我学会了快速学习、团队分工、验证结果以及在时间压力下完成交付。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: What achievement are you most proud of from your undergraduate years? / 本科期间你最有成就感的事情是什么？
questions.answer:
My most memorable competition was the Service Outsourcing Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition. I served as the project leader and also worked on algorithms. The challenge was that we were solving an enterprise-style problem, so the system had to be more than a demo. We had to divide tasks, integrate modules, test repeatedly, and present the final system clearly. We eventually won a national third prize. More importantly, I learned that a good competition project needs both technical depth and reliable delivery.

我最难忘的一次竞赛是服务外包创新创业大赛。我担任项目负责人，同时也参与算法工作。它最特别的地方是企业命题，不是把算法跑出来就结束，而是要做出一个完整、可展示、能稳定运行的系统。我们需要分工、联调、反复测试和准备答辩，最后获得了全国赛企业命题类三等奖。对我来说，这次比赛最大的收获是理解了技术深度和工程交付同样重要。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: How would you summarize your undergraduate experience? / 你如何总结你的本科经历
questions.answer:
My undergraduate years were a process of becoming more independent and academically focused. I worked to build a solid foundation in my major and maintain steady academic performance. I also took the initiative to explore opportunities beyond regular coursework and learned to apply what I had learned in practice through projects and activities. These experiences helped me communicate ideas clearly, work effectively with others, and adapt to unfamiliar tasks.

我的本科阶段是一个逐渐变得更加独立、更加专注于学术成长的过程。我努力在本专业打下扎实基础，并保持稳定的学业表现。我还会主动探索常规课程之外的机会，通过项目和实践活动学习把所学知识运用到实践中。这些经历帮助我学会清楚表达观点、与他人高效合作，并适应陌生任务。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: What strengths do you have that are relevant to this field? / 你有哪些与这个领域相关的优势？
questions.answer:
One strength of mine is persistence. I have played the violin for many years, and the same habit helps me in study and research. When a problem is difficult, I can stay with it and improve step by step. I also like turning ideas into working systems instead of stopping at a concept. One weakness is that I sometimes spend too much time refining details before the main structure is fixed. I am improving this by setting priorities and time limits, and by asking myself what is really necessary at each stage.

我的一个优势是比较能长期坚持。我学小提琴很多年，这种习惯也影响了我的学习和科研：遇到难题时，我愿意一点一点把它做下去。另外，我比较喜欢把想法真正做成可以运行的系统。我的不足是有时会在整体框架还没完全确定时，就花太多时间打磨细节。现在我会先定优先级和时间上限，并不断问自己“这个阶段最需要解决的是什么”。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: How would you evaluate your academic performance in your major? / 你如何评价自己的专业学习表现？
questions.answer:
Good morning, professors. My name is Zhexuan Li. I am a Computer Science student at Hangzhou Dianzi University. My GPA is 4.589 out of 5.0, and I rank 19th out of 465 students. My main project experience is in computer vision, robotics, and AI agents. In an industrial repair-robot project, I worked on visual detection and designed a lightweight attention module called LECA. That work led to a first-author paper. These experiences made me interested in reliable intelligent systems, especially AI agents that can perceive, plan, use tools, and learn from feedback. Thank you.

各位老师好，我叫黎哲轩，来自杭州电子科技大学计算机科学与技术专业。我的GPA是4.589/5.0，专业排名19/465。本科期间，我主要做过计算机视觉、机器人和AI Agent相关项目。在工业维修机器人项目中，我负责视觉检测，并设计了轻量级注意力模块LECA，相关工作形成了一篇第一作者论文。这些经历让我逐渐关注真实场景中的可靠智能系统，尤其是能够感知、规划、调用工具并根据反馈调整的AI Agent。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Why should we offer you a place in our program? / 我们为什么应该录取你？
questions.answer:
Good morning, professors. My name is Zhexuan Li. I am a Computer Science student at Hangzhou Dianzi University. My GPA is 4.589 out of 5.0, and I rank 19th out of 465 students. My main project experience is in computer vision, robotics, and AI agents. In an industrial repair-robot project, I worked on visual detection and designed a lightweight attention module called LECA. That work led to a first-author paper. These experiences made me interested in reliable intelligent systems, especially AI agents that can perceive, plan, use tools, and learn from feedback. Thank you.

各位老师好，我叫黎哲轩，来自杭州电子科技大学计算机科学与技术专业。我的GPA是4.589/5.0，专业排名19/465。本科期间，我主要做过计算机视觉、机器人和AI Agent相关项目。在工业维修机器人项目中，我负责视觉检测，并设计了轻量级注意力模块LECA，相关工作形成了一篇第一作者论文。这些经历让我逐渐关注真实场景中的可靠智能系统，尤其是能够感知、规划、调用工具并根据反馈调整的AI Agent。
tags: P07 个人优势、能力与经历证明

questions.question: Do you plan to pursue a Ph.D. in the future? / 你未来有读博计划吗？
questions.answer:
I am open to pursuing a PhD, but I do not want to give a fixed answer before I have experienced graduate research in depth. For me, a PhD should come from a real interest in a research question and the willingness to work on it for several years, not simply from wanting a higher degree. During my master's study, I hope to build stronger research ability first. If I find a problem that I truly want to continue exploring, I would seriously consider a PhD.

我对读博是开放的，但在真正深入经历研究生科研之前，我不想给一个过于确定的答案。对我来说，读博应该来自对某个研究问题真正长期的兴趣，而不是单纯追求更高学历。硕士阶段我希望先把科研能力做扎实。如果之后遇到一个我确实愿意继续投入几年去研究的问题，我会认真考虑攻读博士。
tags: P08 未来规划与发展路径

questions.question: What is your ideal career? / 你理想的职业是什么？
questions.answer:
I would like to work on AI systems that solve real technical problems, either in research-oriented industry or in an R&D team. I am especially interested in intelligent agents, multimodal systems, and reliable decision-making. At this stage I do not want to limit myself to one job title. What matters more is whether the work allows me to keep learning, build technically meaningful systems, and see how research ideas perform under real constraints.

我希望未来从事能够解决真实技术问题的AI工作，可以是在研究导向的企业，也可以是在研发团队。我比较关注智能体、多模态系统和可靠决策。目前我不想过早限定某一个职位名称，我更看重工作是否能让我持续学习、构建有技术价值的系统，并看到研究想法在真实约束下的表现。
tags: P08 未来规划与发展路径

questions.question: Would you be willing to accept a transfer to another program or research direction? / 你是否愿意接受专业、项目或研究方向的调剂？
questions.answer:
I would consider it seriously rather than accept or reject it immediately. I would first examine whether the new direction would allow me to build on my current foundation and develop stronger research skills. I would also consider whether I could explore the area in greater depth with genuine interest. I want to remain open to different possibilities, but I would still make the decision based on my interests and strengths, the available supervision, and long-term development.

我会认真考虑，而不是立刻接受或拒绝。我会先判断新的方向能否让我在现有基础上继续发展，并培养更扎实的研究能力；同时也会考虑自己是否真的愿意更加深入地探索这个领域。我希望对不同可能性保持开放，但仍会结合个人兴趣和优势、指导条件及长期发展，根据自己的兴趣和优势作出决定。如果匹配度合理，我会把新的规划转化为具体行动，并认真为转变做好准备。
tags: P08 未来规划与发展路径

questions.question: If you continued this project, what would you do next? / 如果继续这个项目，你下一步会怎么做？
questions.answer:
The first limitation is generalization. The system has mainly been tested in a specific repair setting, so performance cannot be assumed in other vehicles or environments. The second limitation is end-to-end reliability. A good detector does not guarantee that coordinates, tool calls, and physical actions will all be correct. The third limitation is evaluation coverage. We still need more failure cases and clearer system-level metrics. I would address these issues with broader testing, structured failure logs, and stricter end-to-end evaluation.

第一类局限是泛化。目前系统主要在特定维修场景中测试，不能直接假设它在其他车辆和环境中同样可靠。第二类是端到端可靠性：检测准确并不等于坐标、工具调用和实际动作都会正确。第三类是评测覆盖，我们还需要更多失败场景和更清晰的系统级指标。下一步我会通过更广泛测试、结构化失败日志以及更严格的端到端评测来改进。
tags: P08 未来规划与发展路径

questions.question: What are your plans for your graduate studies? / 你对研究生阶段有什么规划？
questions.answer:
In the first stage of graduate study, I want to strengthen my foundation and learn the research methods used by the group. I also hope to read important papers and reproduce solid baselines instead of rushing into a new idea. After that, I want to focus on one research problem and build a complete cycle from question, method, experiment, to analysis. By the later stage, I hope I can define problems more independently and produce work that is both technically sound and useful in real settings.

研究生前期，我希望先补强基础，熟悉课题组常用的研究方法，并通过阅读重要论文和复现可靠baseline建立判断力，而不是急着追一个新点子。之后，我希望围绕一个具体问题形成完整的研究闭环，从问题、方法、实验到分析都能做扎实。到后期，我希望自己能够更独立地提出问题，并做出既技术可靠、又对真实场景有价值的工作。

questions.question: What is your favorite movie, and why? / 你最喜欢哪部电影？为什么？
questions.answer:
My favorite English-language movie is Interstellar. The first time I watched it, I was impressed by the scale of the story, the music, and the images of space. But what stayed with me most was the combination of science and human emotion. The film talks about exploration, time, uncertainty, and the choices people make when the future is unclear. I also like that it takes scientific ideas seriously without turning the movie into a lecture. It is a film I can enjoy both emotionally and intellectually.

我最喜欢的英语电影是《星际穿越》。第一次看的时候，我对它宏大的故事、音乐和太空画面印象很深。但真正让我留下来的，是它把科学想象和人的情感放在了一起。电影里讲到了探索、时间、不确定性，以及人在未来并不清楚时怎样做选择。我也很喜欢它认真对待科学概念，但又没有把电影拍成一堂科普课。对我来说，它既有情感上的震撼，也有思考上的吸引力。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Who is a public figure you admire, and why? / 你钦佩哪位公众人物？为什么？
questions.answer:
One public figure I admire is [真实人物]. I admire this person for persistence, professional responsibility, and the ability to remain focused over time. The person's work left a lasting impression on me and broadened my perspective on what meaningful achievement requires. It also shaped the way I see success as a long process rather than a single result.

我钦佩的一位公众人物是 [真实人物]。我因为这个人的坚持、专业责任感和长期保持专注的能力而钦佩他／她。这个人的工作给我留下了长久印象，也拓宽了我对有意义的成就需要哪些条件的认识。它还影响了我把成功理解为长期过程而非单一结果的方式。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: What are your hobbies and interests? / 你有哪些兴趣爱好？
questions.answer:
My main hobby is the violin. I have studied it for about fifteen years, so music has been part of my life for a long time. What I enjoy most is the sound of the instrument and the way music can express emotions that are hard to put into words. I also enjoy ensemble playing, because different parts can come together and create something much richer. Besides music, I like running. When I feel stressed or mentally tired, a short run usually helps me relax and clear my mind.

我最主要的爱好是小提琴，已经学了大约十五年，所以音乐一直是我生活里很重要的一部分。我最喜欢的是小提琴本身的音色，以及音乐能够表达很多很难直接用语言说清楚的情绪。我也很喜欢合奏，不同声部真正配合起来时，会产生比单独演奏更丰富的效果。除此之外，我也喜欢跑步。压力比较大或者脑子很累时，出去跑一会儿通常能让我放松下来。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: What is your favorite sport, and why do you enjoy it? / 你最喜欢什么运动？为什么？
questions.answer:
My favorite form of exercise is running. I like it because it is simple and easy to fit into my schedule. I do not need special equipment or a complicated plan. When I have been studying for a long time or feel stressed, I can just go outside and run for a while. After that, I usually feel more relaxed and my mind is clearer. So for me, running is mainly a way to recharge.

我最喜欢的运动是跑步。它很简单，也很容易安排进日常时间，不需要特别的器材或者复杂的计划。学习时间比较长或者压力比较大时，我就可以直接出去跑一会儿。跑完以后通常会放松很多，脑子也会更清楚。所以对我来说，跑步主要是一种很方便的放松和充电方式。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Tell us about a family member or someone close to you whom you admire. / 请介绍一位你钦佩的家人或身边人。
questions.answer:
I especially admire one of my family members for being responsible, calm, and supportive. This person has played an important part in my life and has shaped the way I see work and relationships. The way this person deals with difficulties left a lasting impression on me and taught me the importance of remaining reliable even under pressure. Because of this influence, I value honesty and responsibility in other people.

我尤其钦佩家里一位亲人的责任感、沉着和支持他人的方式。这个人在我的生活中占有重要位置，并影响了我看待工作和人际关系的方式。他／她处理困难的方式给我留下了长久印象，也让我认识到即使面对压力也要保持可靠的重要性。受此影响，我格外看重他人的真诚和责任感。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you describe a joyful experience from your childhood? / 请介绍一段快乐的童年经历。
questions.answer:
One joyful childhood memory is spending long summer evenings playing outdoors with friends. That experience played an important part in my childhood and left a lasting impression on me because the happiness was simple and shared. It taught me the importance of friendship, curiosity, and being fully present. It also shaped the way I see rest and connection as necessary parts of a balanced life.

童年里一段快乐的记忆，是夏天傍晚与朋友们长时间在户外玩耍。这段经历在我的童年中占有重要位置，也因为那种简单而共同分享的快乐给我留下了长久印象。它让我认识到友谊、好奇心和专注当下的重要性，也影响了我把休息和人与人之间的联系看作平衡生活必要部分的方式。事情本身虽然普通，但这段记忆至今对我仍有意义。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Tell us about an important conversation that influenced you. / 请介绍一次对你产生影响的重要谈话。
questions.answer:
One important conversation was with a teacher when I was uncertain about my academic direction. The teacher's advice left a lasting impression on me and played an important part in how I made my next decision. Instead of telling me exactly what to choose, the teacher encouraged me to examine what questions genuinely interested me. That conversation shaped the way I see important decisions and taught me the importance of taking responsibility for my own choices.

一次对我很重要的谈话发生在我对学术方向感到不确定时，对象是一位老师。老师的建议给我留下了长久印象，也在我作出下一步决定的过程中占有重要位置。老师没有直接告诉我应该选择什么，而是鼓励我认真思考哪些问题真正吸引自己。那次谈话影响了我看待重要决定的方式，也让我认识到为个人选择承担责任的重要性。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Describe someone you enjoy studying or working with. / 请介绍一位你喜欢共同学习或工作的人。
questions.answer:
I enjoy working with people who are reliable, open, and willing to communicate. One classmate in particular has played an important part in several of my team experiences. I value this person's honesty and sense of responsibility, and I admire the way this person listens before expressing a different opinion. Working together has taught me the importance of clear expectations and mutual support and has shaped the way I see effective cooperation.

我喜欢与可靠、开放并愿意沟通的人一起学习或工作。有一位同学在我的多次团队经历中占有重要位置。我看重这个人的真诚和责任感，也钦佩他／她在表达不同意见前认真倾听的方式。共同合作让我认识到清晰预期和相互支持的重要性，也影响了我看待高效合作的方式。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you briefly describe a city you know well or have visited? / 请介绍一座你熟悉或到访过的城市。
questions.answer:
One city I know very well is Hangzhou, because it is my hometown and I am also studying there. It is best known for West Lake, and places such as Leifeng Pagoda and Baoshi Hill are part of the city's landscape. Hangzhou also has a strong digital economy and a very active Internet and technology industry. What I like about the city is this mix of tradition and innovation. It can be energetic and fast-moving, but there are also many places where you can slow down.

我很熟悉的一座城市是杭州，因为这里既是我的家乡，也是我现在读大学的地方。杭州最有代表性的当然是西湖，雷峰塔、宝石山等也构成了城市很有辨识度的风景。与此同时，杭州的数字经济和互联网、科技产业也非常活跃。我很喜欢它传统与创新并存的感觉：城市发展很快，但也有很多地方可以让人慢下来。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you introduce a local specialty from your hometown? / 请介绍一种家乡特色美食。
questions.answer:
One Hangzhou specialty I would introduce is Dongpo pork. It is a well-known local dish made with pork that is slowly cooked until it becomes very tender. The flavor is rich, but the cooking also gives it a soft texture. It is closely connected with Hangzhou's food culture and is something many visitors know about. If I were introducing Hangzhou food to a friend for the first time, this would be one of the dishes I would mention.

如果介绍一种杭州特色美食，我会想到东坡肉。它是杭州比较有代表性的一道菜，猪肉经过慢炖以后口感很软，味道也比较浓郁。它和杭州的饮食文化联系得很紧，也是很多游客对杭州美食比较熟悉的印象。如果第一次给外地朋友介绍杭州菜，我会把它作为比较有代表性的一道菜来讲。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you briefly introduce your undergraduate university? / 请简要介绍你的本科院校。
questions.answer:
I study at Hangzhou Dianzi University, usually called HDU. It is a university in Hangzhou with strong features in electronic information and computing-related fields. The school has a practical culture. Students are encouraged to join competitions, engineering projects, and research quite early. That is one reason I was able to take part in projects and competitions during my undergraduate years. Campus life is also active, with many clubs and cultural activities. Overall, HDU has given me both a solid academic foundation and many chances to learn by doing.

我就读于杭州电子科技大学，通常简称杭电。学校位于杭州，在电子信息和计算机相关领域有比较鲜明的特色。杭电的实践氛围很强，学生比较早就有机会参加竞赛、工程项目和科研训练，这也是我本科阶段能够较早接触项目和比赛的一个重要原因。同时学校的社团和文化活动也很丰富。总体来说，杭电既给了我比较扎实的专业基础，也给了我很多通过实践去学习的机会。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you tell us something about your hometown? / 请介绍一下你的家乡。
questions.answer:
I am from Hangzhou, the capital of Zhejiang Province, and I am also studying there now. Hangzhou is best known for West Lake, and places such as Leifeng Pagoda and Baoshi Hill are part of the city's landscape. It is also famous for local food such as Dongpo pork and xiaolongbao. At the same time, Hangzhou has a strong digital economy and an active Internet and technology industry. I like this mix of tradition and innovation. Growing up there has made me open to new things, but I also enjoy the slower side of the city, especially watching the sunrise near West Lake.

我的家乡是杭州，也是我现在读大学的地方。杭州最有代表性的当然是西湖，雷峰塔、宝石山等都是城市里很有辨识度的景点。杭州也有东坡肉、小笼包等比较有名的本地美食。与此同时，杭州的数字经济和互联网、科技产业也很活跃。我很喜欢这种传统与创新并存的感觉。这里让我比较愿意接受新事物，但我也很喜欢杭州慢下来的一面，比如去西湖附近看日出。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Are there any special customs or traditions in your hometown? / 你的家乡有哪些特别的风俗或传统？
questions.answer:
My hometown is best known for several traditions connected with festivals and family gatherings. These customs have played an important part in local life because they bring different generations together. Taking part in them when I was younger left a lasting impression on me and shaped the way I see the relationship between tradition and community. They also taught me the importance of preserving culture without rejecting change.

我的家乡以一些与节日和家庭团聚相关的传统最为人熟知。这些习俗在当地生活中占有重要位置，因为它们把不同年龄的人联系在一起。小时候参与这些活动的经历给我留下了长久印象，也影响了我看待传统与社区关系的方式。它们还让我认识到在接受变化的同时保留文化的重要性。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you briefly tell us about your family? / 请简要介绍你的家庭。
questions.answer:
There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my younger sister, and me. My father works as a financial director at a company. My mother is retired now. My younger sister is in the fifth grade, so there is quite a big age difference between us. We live in Hangzhou. My family atmosphere is relaxed and supportive. My parents usually give me space to make my own decisions, but they also give practical advice when I need it.

我家里有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、妹妹和我。爸爸在一家公司担任财务总监，妈妈现在已经退休。妹妹现在读五年级，所以我们年龄差比较大。我们一家都生活在杭州。家里的氛围比较轻松，也很支持我的选择。父母通常会让我自己做决定，但在我需要的时候也会给我一些很实际的建议。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: What kinds of books do you usually enjoy reading? / 你平时喜欢读什么类型的书？
questions.answer:
I mainly read technical books, especially books about AI systems and algorithms. One example is Deep Learning Recommender Systems 2.0 by Wang Zhe. I like this kind of book because it gives me a more systematic view of how a field develops. Papers are useful for learning specific new ideas, and AI tools can answer isolated questions very quickly. But a good technical book can connect basic concepts, classical methods, engineering practice, and newer directions into one structure. That kind of map is especially valuable when I enter a field that is new to me.

我平时主要读技术类书籍，尤其是人工智能系统和算法相关的书，比如王喆的《深度学习推荐系统2.0》。我喜欢这类书，是因为它能帮助我形成一个领域更系统的认识。论文适合了解具体的新方法，AI 工具也可以很快回答零散问题，但一本好的技术书可以把基础概念、经典方法、工程实践和较新的方向串成一个完整结构。对于刚进入一个新领域时，这种整体脉络尤其有价值。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you introduce one of your favorite books? / 请介绍一本你喜欢的书。
questions.answer:
One technical book I like is Deep Learning Recommender Systems 2.0 by Wang Zhe. It gives a systematic introduction to recommender systems and connects classical methods with deep learning and more recent developments. What I value most is not one particular algorithm. It is the structure of the book. It helps me see how different ideas are related and why the field developed in this way. In the AI era, we can get answers to individual questions very quickly, but a well-organized book still gives a coherent map that is hard to replace.

我比较喜欢的一本技术书是王喆的《深度学习推荐系统2.0》。它比较系统地介绍了推荐系统，把经典方法、深度学习以及较新的发展串在一起。我最看重的其实不是某一个具体算法，而是整本书提供的结构。它能让我看到不同方法之间是什么关系，以及这个领域为什么会这样发展。现在用 AI 很快就能得到某个具体问题的答案，但一本组织得好的书仍然能提供一种比较难替代的整体脉络。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Could you share a memorable experience from your undergraduate years? / 请分享一段难忘的本科经历。
questions.answer:
One of my most memorable undergraduate experiences was a quantitative-investment competition. Finance was not a field I knew well at the beginning, so the first challenge was simply to understand the problem. We had only a few days to read related materials, divide the work, learn what we needed, and turn the idea into a complete solution. The process was intense, but our team kept discussing, testing, and improving the work until the deadline. We eventually won a provincial first prize. What made the experience memorable was learning how quickly a team can enter an unfamiliar field when everyone keeps the problem structured and works together under pressure.

我本科阶段很难忘的一段经历，是参加一次量化投资竞赛。刚开始时，金融并不是我熟悉的领域，所以第一个挑战其实是先把问题弄明白。我们只有几天时间去查资料、分工、补需要的知识，再把想法做成一个完整方案。整个过程节奏很快，但团队一直在讨论、测试和改进，直到截止前把方案完善出来。最后我们获得了省级一等奖。让我印象最深的是，只要把问题拆清楚并且合作顺畅，一个团队可以在很短时间内进入陌生领域并完成交付。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: Which teacher had the greatest influence on you, and why? / 哪位老师对你影响最大？为什么？
questions.answer:
The teacher who influenced me most is one of my research supervisors. I remember a time when a music-recommendation project was not making progress. I had tried several ideas and started to feel that the direction itself might be wrong. My supervisor called me in the evening and helped me rethink the problem. He suggested that I step back from the current method and explore a different modeling direction, including diffusion-based approaches. What impressed me most was not one specific technique. It was the way he helped me question my assumptions instead of blindly continuing. Since then, when a project gets stuck, I try to ask whether the problem is in the implementation or in the direction itself.

对我影响最大的一位老师，是我的科研导师。有一次我做音乐推荐项目一直没有进展，尝试了几个方案以后，我开始怀疑是不是整个方向都有问题。老师晚上还专门和我通话，帮我重新梳理问题，并建议我先跳出来看当前方法，再考虑包括扩散模型在内的其他建模思路。真正让我印象深刻的不是某一个具体技术，而是老师让我学会：科研卡住时，不要只是沿着原路线继续硬调，而要进一步去质疑自己的假设。后来我遇到问题时，也会更主动地先判断是实现问题还是方向问题。
tags: P09 个人背景、兴趣、人物与价值观

questions.question: What do you think about young people buying luxury or famous-brand products? / 你如何看待年轻人购买奢侈品或名牌产品？
questions.answer:
I do not think buying a famous brand is automatically right or wrong; the judgment should depend on the specific context. We should consider both personal preference and financial ability and look beyond the immediate satisfaction of the purchase. Young people need to recognize the trade-offs involved, including savings, family circumstances, and the pressure created by comparison. They should also take responsibility for the consequences of their spending.

我不认为购买名牌本身必然正确或错误，判断应当取决于具体情境。我们需要同时考虑个人偏好和经济能力，并不只看消费带来的即时满足。年轻人应当认识到其中的权衡，包括储蓄、家庭情况以及攀比带来的压力，也需要为消费后果承担责任。在我看来，健康消费应当平衡个人选择与社会责任，不应依靠品牌证明个人价值。

questions.question: Should universities provide more support for students from disadvantaged backgrounds? / 高校是否应该为弱势背景学生提供更多支持？
questions.answer:
Yes. I would define educational fairness in terms of meaningful access to learning opportunities, not simply identical treatment. The support needed may depend on the specific context, so universities should consider both financial barriers and academic or psychological needs. Policies should look beyond the immediate outcome of admission and support students throughout their studies.

应该。我会从能否真正获得学习机会的角度定义教育公平，而不是把公平简单理解为完全相同的对待。所需支持会取决于具体情境，因此高校应当同时考虑经济障碍以及学业和心理需求。相关政策还应不只看录取这一眼前结果，而要在学生整个学习过程中提供支持。

questions.question: How should society address the problem of objects being thrown from high-rise buildings? / 社会应如何治理高空抛物问题？
questions.answer:
This is a serious public-safety issue, and we should distinguish the cause from the symptom. Punishment may be necessary, but prevention also requires cooperation among different groups, including residents, property managers, schools, and public authorities. Measures should consider both individual responsibility and community prevention, and their effectiveness should be based on reliable evidence. People who cause harm must take responsibility for the consequences, while buildings and communities should improve education, reporting, and appropriate safety systems.

这是一个严重的公共安全问题，我们需要区分问题的原因与表象。处罚可能是必要的，但预防同样需要不同群体共同合作，包括居民、物业、学校和公共部门。相关措施应当同时考虑个人责任和社区预防，并依据可靠证据判断措施是否有效。造成伤害的人必须为行为后果承担责任，楼宇和社区也应改善教育、报告机制及适当的安全设施。
tags: P10 观点分析、学术评价与社会议题

questions.question: What do you think defines high-quality or first-rate research? / 你认为高质量或一流研究的标准是什么？
questions.answer:
For me, high-quality research starts with a clear and worthwhile question. Then the method and experiments should actually answer that question, rather than only produce a better number. The evidence should be strong enough to support the claim, and the comparison should be fair and reproducible. I also think good research needs a clear boundary. It should explain not only where a method works, but also where it may fail. So I would summarize it as: a meaningful question, convincing evidence, and an honest understanding of the limits.

我理解的高质量研究，首先要有一个清楚而且值得研究的问题。之后的方法和实验应该真正回答这个问题，而不是只追求更高的指标。证据要足以支持结论，对比也应该公平、可复现。我还觉得好的研究要把边界讲清楚：不仅说明方法在哪些地方有效，也要说明它可能在什么情况下失效。所以如果概括成三点，就是有意义的问题、可信的证据，以及对方法边界诚实而清楚的理解。

questions.question: What qualities do you think an excellent researcher should have? / 你认为优秀研究者应该具备哪些品质？
questions.answer:
I think an excellent researcher needs curiosity, independent learning, and rigor. Curiosity helps you keep asking why a problem matters. Independent learning is important because research rarely gives you a complete roadmap. Rigor means that you respect evidence, even when the result is different from what you hoped for. I would also add reflection. Persistence matters, but if you never question your assumptions, persistence can turn into wasted effort. So a good researcher should be able to keep learning and also update their judgment when the evidence changes.

我觉得优秀研究者至少需要好奇心、自主学习能力和严谨性。好奇心让人持续追问一个问题为什么值得做；自主学习很重要，因为科研通常不会给你一张完整路线图；严谨则意味着尊重证据，即使实验结果和自己希望的不一样。我还会再加一点反思能力。坚持当然重要，但如果从不质疑自己的假设，坚持也可能变成无效投入。所以好的研究者既要能持续学习，也要能在证据变化时及时更新自己的判断。

questions.question: How do you define success? / 你如何定义成功？
questions.answer:
For me, success is not one final result. It is being able to keep moving toward a direction that I value while becoming more capable and more independent. Awards and offers are important because they give feedback, but they are not the whole definition. I would feel successful if I can keep learning, do work that is useful, take responsibility for my choices, and still maintain the ability to enjoy life and relationships outside work.

对我来说，成功不是某一个最终结果，而是在自己认可的方向上持续前进，并变得更有能力、更独立。奖项和offer当然重要，因为它们提供反馈，但不是全部。我会把能够持续学习、做有价值的事情、对自己的选择负责，同时仍然保有工作之外的生活和关系，看作一种更长期的成功。
